brief: Interlocking metallic gears of varying sizes rotate within a dark, industrial 3D environment. The teeth of the gears mesh tightly, transferring motion from the fast-spinning small gears to the slow, heavy rotation of the larger ones. As the gears turn, a heavy flywheel at the end of the sequence spins with immense torque. Dragging the mouse rotates a central drive gear, changing the speed and direction of the entire interconnected system.

statement: This sketch presents a mechanical system of interlocking gears rotating in a dark, industrial 3D space. The visualization demonstrates how motion transfers through a gear train, with smaller, faster gears driving larger, slower ones. A central flywheel spins with great torque at the end of this chain, representing the culmination of the mechanical energy transfer. Viewers can interact by dragging their mouse across the canvas to change the rotation speed and direction of the entire system. The scene subtly pulses with light that responds to the average speed of the gears, enhancing the sense of mechanical rhythm and energy flow within the rotating machinery.
